durabilitytweaks.title: Durability Tweaks
durabilitytweaks.subtitle: Armor colour follows its durability · by betongoat
durabilitytweaks.client_only: Client-side only - works on every server.
durabilitytweaks.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns all armor colouring on or off.
durabilitytweaks.option.style.full.toolt: The whole armor takes the durability colour, like a classic dura pack.
durabilitytweaks.option.style.outline.to: The armor keeps its look, only its edges are coloured.
durabilitytweaks.option.style.none.toolt: The armor stays vanilla - combine it with the number.
durabilitytweaks.option.palette.tooltip: Colour scale used for the durability levels. ✎ lets you set your own colours.
durabilitytweaks.option.outline.tooltip: Width of the coloured border in the Outline style.
durabilitytweaks.option.number.helmet_an: Remaining durability on the helmet and the chestplate.
durabilitytweaks.option.format.tooltip: Percent of durability left, or the exact durability points left.
durabilitytweaks.option.show_at_full.too: Also show the number on undamaged armor. Without it, full armor looks completely vanilla.
durabilitytweaks.option.filter.tooltip: Netherite changes colour every 10% down to 20%, then every 5%. Other armor changes every 10% down to 10%, plus two extra colours for intense PvP (10-5% and 5-0%).
durabilitytweaks.option.reset.tooltip: Restore every setting to its default value.
durabilitytweaks.preview.tooltip: Only changes the preview, not your settings.
durabilitytweaks.option.owners.tooltip: Colour everyone's armor, only yours, or only other players' and mobs'.
durabilitytweaks.inspect.nothing: Look at a player or mob first.
durabilitytweaks.inspect.head: Helmet
durabilitytweaks.inspect.all_full: All armor shows full durability. If this player was surely hit, the server hides other players' armor durability - then no mod or dura pack can show it.
durabilitytweaks.tab.look.intro: How damaged armor looks. Pick a style, then the colour scale - or make your own with ✎. Hover over any option to see what it does.
durabilitytweaks.tab.number.intro: The number shows how much durability is left. Choose where it appears and how it looks.
durabilitytweaks.tab.icons.intro: Armor icons in the hotbar, in armor HUD mods and (optionally) in inventories take the durability colour too.
durabilitytweaks.tab.general.intro: Turn the mod on or off and choose which armor gets coloured.
durabilitytweaks.option.size.tooltip: Size of the digits on the armor.
durabilitytweaks.option.color.tooltip: Auto: light digits on coloured armor, coloured digits on outline or plain armor.
durabilitytweaks.option.icons.tooltip: Colour armor item icons by durability. HUD: hotbar and armor HUD mods. Everywhere: inventories too.
durabilitytweaks.option.edit_colors.tool: Edit your own colours for every durability level.
durabilitytweaks.editor.title: Your colours
durabilitytweaks.editor.subtitle: Click a durability level, then change its colour
durabilitytweaks.editor.slot.tooltip: Netherite range. Diamond uses the same colours (10-19% uses the 15-19% colour).
durabilitytweaks.editor.load.tooltip: Replace all twelve colours with this palette.
